description:
Inbox Zero: https://getinboxzero.com
Conductor Build: https://conductor.build

Running one AI coding agent at a time is limiting. In this video, I show you Conductor Build — the tool I've been using to run multiple Claude Code agents in parallel across different repos. It handles git work trees automatically, so you can have 5+ agents working on different features simultaneously without conflicts.

0:00 - Intro & why I use Conductor
0:30 - Getting started
1:00 - Running agents on multiple repos
2:30 - Automatic branch & work tree creation
4:00 - Creating PRs from the UI
5:30 - Setup scripts & custom ports
7:00 - Full workflow: code to merge

1️⃣ How Conductor manages git work trees automatically (no manual setup)
2️⃣ Running agents across multiple repos at once
3️⃣ Built-in PR creation and merge workflow
4️⃣ Setup scripts for npm install, dev servers on different ports
5️⃣ Why this beats using Claude Code or Cursor alone for parallel work

If you're only running one AI agent at a time, you're leaving speed on the table.

===================
My open source product, Inbox Zero:
Inbox Zero organizes your inbox, drafts replies in your voice, and helps you reach inbox zero fast. Never miss an important email again.
https://getinboxzero.com
GitHub: https://github.com/elie222/inbox-zero ⭐
